description: One dataset row per asset (video clean/watermarked, audio, cover, slideshow frame, metadata) plus explicit status rows for unavailable, private, region-blocked, age-gated, duplicate, over-limit, and too-large inputs. Each row carries post identity, variant, quality, MIME type, byte size, dimensions, duration, stable Key-Value Store link, original CDN URL, expiry, and status.
